nodes.title: SG-5.4.3 Add game/tests/preload.test.ts with mocked dependencies
nodes.body:
Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey live in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts and BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) uses both. Separate tests exist (game/tests/planPreload.test.ts, resolveTextureKey.test.ts, frontend/tests/bootScene*.test.ts), but game/tests/preload.test.ts does not exist. Desired behavior: one file with every dependency mocked covering deduplication, the unknown-reference issue, the fallback key and BootScene using the planner and fallback. Why: SG-5.4.3 asks for exactly this file.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/tests/preload.test.ts, when `npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts` runs in game/, then it passes
- Given an asset referenced twice, when planned, then it is loaded once
- Given a ref missing from the manifest, when planned, then it is reported unknown and not loaded
- Given an unknown id, when resolved, then the fallback key is returned
- Given BootScene.preload, when run with mocks, then only planned assets load and unknown refs warn


## Scope
- In scope: game/tests/preload.test.ts
- In scope: game/vitest.config.ts alias so game tests can import BootScene
- Out of scope: Changing planPreload or BootScene behavior
- Out of scope: Browser or Phaser runtime tests
- Preserve: Existing planPreload, resolveTextureKey and bootScene tests
- Preserve: game/frontend/vitest.config.ts


## Technical constraints
- Mock phaser, the content module, and the filesystem; no real Phaser or network
- Test lives in game/tests/preload.test.ts exactly


## Definition of done
- preload.test.ts exists and passes
- Existing game tests still pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves planner dedup, unknown refs and fallback key
nodes.body:
Context: planPreload dedupes via a Set and splits load/unknown against the manifest; resolveTextureKey returns the fallback for undefined or unknown ids. Desired behavior: preload.test.ts asserts these with an in-memory manifest. Expected result: the three behaviors are covered in the requested file. Why: SG-5.4.3 done-when.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given two objects with asset 'A' in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then load equals ['A'] and unknown is []
- Given asset 'Z' and dust asset 'Y' not in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then unknown equals ['Z','Y'] and load is []
- Given id 'Z' or undefined, when resolveTextureKey runs with fallback 'fb', then 'fb' is returned; given 'A', then 'A'


## Scope
- In scope: Engine-level assertions in preload.test.ts
- Out of scope: BootScene assertions
- Preserve: planPreload semantics


## Technical constraints
- Use in-memory AssetManifest and fixtures/valid-world


## Definition of done
- Cases pass via vitest


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves BootScene uses the planner and fallback
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene imports '@game/...' aliases, which game/vitest.config.ts does not define, so game/tests cannot import it. Desired behavior: add the alias and test BootScene with phaser, content and fallback loader mocked. Expected result: tests show only planned assets load, unknown refs warn, and resolveKey returns 'fallback:missing' for unknown or failed ids. Why: SG-5.4.3 done-when.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene refs 'objects/bed' (known) and 'objects/ghost' (unknown), when preload runs, then load.image is called once for the bed and console.warn reports ghost
- Given preload ran, when generateTexture is inspected, then it was called with 'fallback:missing'
- Given an unknown or loaderror-failed id, when resolveKey runs, then 'fallback:missing' is returned; known id returns itself


## Scope
- In scope: @game alias in game/vitest.config.ts
- In scope: BootScene assertions in preload.test.ts
- Out of scope: Changing BootScene
- Preserve: Existing game test include pattern


## Technical constraints
- vi.mock('phaser') and the content module; no real Phaser


## Definition of done
- BootScene cases pass from game/tests


## Clarifying questions
- None
